title: Toronto Gestational Glucose Tolerance Cohort
summary: In this prospective observational cohort study, women representing the full spectrum of gestational glucose tolerance status are undergoing longitudinal cardiometabolic characterization at regular intervals in the years after the index pregnancy.

interventions.name: There is no intervention. An exposure of interest is glucose tolerance status in pregnancy

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant women

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pre-existing diabetes before the index pregnancy
